user.title: Choose a data source
user.description: Both give the same departures and alerts. RailData is NJ Transit's documented API: it needs a free developer account from developer.njtransit.com, and at New York Penn it reports the platform from the signalling system about ten minutes before the board posts it.

menu_options.raildata: RailData API (developer account; shows tracks earlier)

raildata.title: RailData account
raildata.description: The production credentials NJ Transit emailed when you registered. They are checked now and stored in this entry.

commute.title: Add a commute
commute.description: Each commute is a separate entry. Add the integration again for a different destination, or for the trip home.

data_description.destination: Optional. Narrows departures to trains that actually reach this station, including ones requiring a transfer.

reconfigure.title: Change data source
reconfigure.description: Switch this commute to the other API. Stations and options are kept.

menu_options.raildata: RailData API (developer account; shows tracks earlier)

reauth_confirm.title: RailData credentials rejected
reauth_confirm.description: NJ Transit no longer accepts the stored username and password. Enter the current ones.

error.invalid_station: NJ Transit does not recognize that station.
error.invalid_auth: NJ Transit rejected that username and password.
error.quota: Today's RailData sign-in limit has been used up. Try again after midnight Eastern.

abort.already_configured: This commute is already set up.

init.title: Commute options
init.description: The destination is part of this entry's identity and cannot be changed here. Add another commute instead.

data.delay_threshold: Delay before the commute counts as disrupted
data.lookahead: How far ahead to watch for disruption

data_description.departure_interval: NJ Transit caches responses for 30 seconds, so polling faster gains nothing.
data_description.lookahead: Departures beyond this window are ignored by the disruption sensor.
data_description.favorite_trains: Train numbers you usually catch, e.g. 6662. Leave empty to skip the favorite sensor entirely.
